lemma Zn_neq1_cyclic_group:
  assumes "n \<noteq> 1"
  shows "cyclic_group (Z n) 1"
trg:
using assms
proof (unfold_locales)
  show "group (Z n) 1"
    by (simp add: group_Z)
  show "generator (Z n) 1"
  proof (unfold generator_def, rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> generator (Z n) 1"
    then obtain a where "a \<in> Z n" "a \<noteq> 1" "a ^ order (Z n) 1 = 1"
      by (auto simp: generator_def)
    then have "order (Z n) a = order (Z n) 1"
      by (metis order_eq_1_iff_cyclic)
    then have "order (Z n) a = n"
      by (simp add: order_Z)
    then have "a ^ n = 1"
      by (metis \<open>a \<in> Z n\<close> order_Z)
    then have "a ^ n mod n = 1 mod n"
      by (metis mod_eq_self)
    then have "a ^ n = 1 mod n"
      by (metis mod_eq_self)
    then have "a ^ n = 1"
      by (metis \<open>a \<in> Z n\<close> Z_def)
    then have "a = 1"
      by (metis \<open>a ^ n = 1\<close> assms power_eq_1_iff)
    then show False
      using \<open>a \<noteq> 1\<close> by blast
  qed
qed

lemma (in group) ord_conv_Least: (* Manuel Eberl *)
  assumes "x \<in> carrier G" "\<exists>n::nat > 0. x [^] n = \<one>"
  shows   "ord x = (LEAST n::nat. 0 < n \<and> x [^] n = \<one>)"
trg:
proof (rule antisym)
  show "ord x \<le> (LEAST n::nat. 0 < n \<and> x [^] n = \<one>)"
  proof (rule Least_le)
    show "0 < ord x" using assms(2) by (auto simp: ord_gt_0)
    show "x [^] ord x = \<one>" using assms(1) by (rule ord_elems)
  qed
next
  show "(LEAST n::nat. 0 < n \<and> x [^] n = \<one>) \<le> ord x"
  proof (rule LeastI2_ex)
    show "\<exists>n::nat. 0 < n \<and> x [^] n = \<one>" using assms(2) .
    fix n::nat assume "0 < n \<and> x [^] n = \<one>"
    thus "n \<ge> (LEAST n::nat. 0 < n \<and> x [^] n = \<one>)"
      by (intro Least_le)
  qed
qed

end

lemma (in group_hom) vimage_eq_set_mult_kern_right:
  assumes "A \<subseteq> carrier G"
  shows "{x \<in> carrier G. h x \<in> h ` A} = A <#> kernel G H h"
trg:
proof (unfold set_mult_def, rule equalityI)
  show "{x \<in> carrier G. h x \<in> h ` A} \<subseteq> A <#> kernel G H h"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix x assume "x \<in> {x \<in> carrier G. h x \<in> h ` A}"
    then have "x \<in> carrier G" and "h x \<in> h ` A" by auto
    then obtain a where "a \<in> A" and "h x = h a" by auto
    then have "x = a \<otimes> (inv_op a x)" using assms(1) by (metis inv_op_closed inv_op_inv_op_closed)
    moreover have "inv_op a x \<in> kernel G H h"
    proof (unfold kernel_def, rule conjI)
      show "inv_op a x \<in> carrier G" using assms(1) by (metis inv_op_closed)
      show "h (inv_op a x) = \<one>\<^bsub>H\<^esub>" using assms(1) by (metis inv_op_closed inv_op_inv_op_closed)
    qed
    ultimately show "x \<in> A <#> kernel G H h" by (metis set_multI)
  qed
next
  show "A <#> kernel G H h \<subseteq> {x \<in> carrier G. h x \<in> h ` A}"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix x assume "x \<in> A <#> kernel G H h"
    then obtain a k where "a \<in> A" and "k \<in> kernel G H h" and "x = a \<otimes> k" by (metis set_multE)
    then have "h x = h a \<otimes>\<^bsub>H\<^esub> h k" using assms(1) by (metis hom_mult)
    moreover have "h k = \<one>\<^bsub>H\<^esub>" using assms(1) by (metis kernel_def)
    ultimately show "x \<in> {x \<in> carrier G. h x \<in> h ` A}" using assms(1) by (metis imageI)
  qed
qed

end

lemma (in group_hom) subgroup_vimage_is_subgroup:
  assumes "subgroup I H"
  shows "subgroup {x \<in> carrier G. h x \<in> I} G" (is "subgroup ?J G")
trg:
proof (rule subgroupI)
  show "?J \<subseteq> carrier G"
    using hom_closed by blast
next
  show "?J \<noteq> {}"
    using assms(1) hom_one by blast
next
  fix x y
  assume "x \<in> ?J" "y \<in> ?J"
  then have "h x \<in> I" "h y \<in> I"
    by auto
  then have "h (x \<otimes> y) = h x \<otimes>\<^bsub>H\<^esub> h y"
    using hom_mult by blast
  then have "x \<otimes> y \<in> ?J"
    using assms(1) hom_closed by blast
  then show "x \<otimes> y \<in> ?J"
    by blast
next
  fix x
  assume "x \<in> ?J"
  then have "h x \<in> I"
    by auto
  then have "h (inv\<^bsub>G\<^esub> x) = inv\<^bsub>H\<^esub> (h x)"
    using assms(1) hom_inv by blast
  then have "inv\<^bsub>G\<^esub> x \<in> ?J"
    using assms(1) hom_closed by blast
  then show "inv\<^bsub>G\<^esub> x \<in> ?J"
    by blast
qed

lemma finite_ne_remove_induct:
  assumes "finite B" "B \<noteq> {}"
    "\<And>A. finite A  \<Longrightarrow> A \<subseteq> B \<Longrightarrow> A \<noteq> {} \<Longrightarrow>
         (\<And>x. x \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> A - {x} \<noteq> {} \<Longrightarrow> P (A - {x})) \<Longrightarrow> P A"
  shows "P B"
trg:
using assms proof (induction "card B" arbitrary: B rule: less_induct)
  case less
  show ?case
  proof (cases "B = {x}")
    case True
    then show ?thesis using assms(2) by auto
  next
    case False
    then obtain x where "x \<in> B" by auto
    have "B - {x} \<subseteq> B" by auto
    have "finite (B - {x})" using assms(1) by auto
    have "card (B - {x}) < card B" using card_Diff_singleton[OF assms(1) `x \<in> B`] `B \<noteq> {}` by auto
    have "B - {x} \<noteq> {}" using `B \<noteq> {}` by auto
    have "P (B - {x})" using less(1)[OF `card (B - {x}) < card B` `finite (B - {x})` `B - {x} \<subseteq> B` `B - {x} \<noteq> {}`] by auto
    then show ?thesis using `x \<in> B` by auto
  qed
qed

end

lemma finite_psubset_inc_induct:
  assumes "finite A" "X \<subseteq> A"
  assumes "\<And>X. (\<And>Y. X \<subset> Y \<Longrightarrow> Y \<subseteq> A \<Longrightarrow> P Y) \<Longrightarrow> P X"
  shows "P X"
trg:
using assms(1,2) proof (induction "card A - card X" arbitrary: X rule: less_induct)
  case less
  show ?case
  proof (cases "X = A")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      using assms(3)[of A] by simp
  next
    case False
    then obtain a where a: "a \<in> A - X"
      using assms(2) by blast
    define Y where "Y = X \<union> {a}"
    have "X \<subset> Y" "Y \<subseteq> A"
      using a unfolding Y_def by auto
    have "card Y = card X + 1"
      unfolding Y_def using a by (simp add: card_insert_disjoint)
    then have "card A - card Y < card A - card X"
      using a by simp
    have "P Y"
      using less.hyps[of Y] `X \<subset> Y` `Y \<subseteq> A` by simp
    then show ?thesis
      using assms(3)[of X] by simp
  qed
qed

end

  assumes comp: "conditionally_complete A r"
  assumes "X \<subseteq> A" and "X \<noteq> {}"
  shows "(\<exists>s. extreme_bound A r X s) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>b\<in>A. bound X r b)"
trg:
using assms
proof (intro iffI)
  assume "\<exists>s. extreme_bound A r X s"
  then obtain s where s: "extreme_bound A r X s" by auto
  then have "bound X r s" by (auto simp: extreme_bound_def)
  then show "\<exists>b\<in>A. bound X r b" using s by auto
next
  assume "\<exists>b\<in>A. bound X r b"
  then obtain b where b: "b \<in> A" "bound X r b" by auto
  then have "extreme_bound A r X b" using assms
    by (auto simp: extreme_bound_def)
  then show "\<exists>s. extreme_bound A r X s" by auto
qed

end

lemma semiattractive_extend:
  fixes r (infix "\<sqsubseteq>" 50)
  assumes A: "semiattractive A (\<sqsubseteq>)" and B: "semiattractive B (\<sqsubseteq>)"
    and AB: "\<forall>a \<in> A. \<forall>b \<in> B. a \<sqsubseteq> b \<and> \<not> b \<sqsubseteq> a"
  shows "semiattractive (A \<union> B) (\<sqsubseteq>)"
trg:
proof (unfold semiattractive_def, rule allI, rule impI)
  fix x y
  assume "x \<in> A \<union> B" and "y \<in> A \<union> B"
  then consider (A1) "x \<in> A" "y \<in> A" | (A2) "x \<in> A" "y \<in> B" | (B1) "x \<in> B" "y \<in> A" | (B2) "x \<in> B" "y \<in> B" by auto
  then show "x \<sqsubseteq> y \<or> y \<sqsubseteq> x"
  proof cases
    case A1
    then show ?thesis using A by (auto simp: semiattractive_def)
  next
    case A2
    then show ?thesis using AB A by (auto simp: semiattractive_def)
  next
    case B1
    then show ?thesis using AB B by (auto simp: semiattractive_def)
  next
    case B2
    then show ?thesis using B by (auto simp: semiattractive_def)
  qed
qed

theorem SC_completeness:
  fixes p :: \<open>(nat, nat) form\<close>

  then have \<open>list_all (eval e f g) ps \<longrightarrow> eval e f g p\<close> by simp
  then have \<open>list_all (eval e f g) (ps @ [compl p])\<close>
    using compl_correct by simp
  then have \<open>eval e f g (compl p)\<close>

P t\<^sub>1 u\<^sub>1 env\<^sub>1 \<Longrightarrow> match t\<^sub>1 u\<^sub>1 = Some env\<^sub>1 \<Longrightarrow> P t\<^sub>2 u\<^sub>2 env\<^sub>2 \<Longrightarrow> match t\<^sub>2 u\<^sub>2 = Some env\<^sub>2 \<Longrightarrow> P (t\<^sub>1 $ t\<^sub>2) (app u\<^sub>1 u\<^sub>2) (env\<^sub>1 ++\<^sub>f env\<^sub>2)"

trg:
using assms
proof (induction xs)

    case True

      by (simp add: Cons.IH)
    also have "\<dots> = map_option (\<lambda>i. if i < n then i else Suc i) (find_first x (insert_nth n y (z # xs)))"
      by (simp add: find_first_Cons)
    finally show ?thesis .

trg:

lemma wffp:
"wffp sl \<longleftrightarrow> sl \<noteq> [] \<and> (\<forall> i. Suc i < length sl \<longrightarrow> sl!(Suc i) \<in> \<delta>(sl!i))"
(is "?L \<longleftrightarrow> ?A \<and> (\<forall> i. ?R i)")

lemma wffp_append:
assumes sl: "wffp sl" and sl1: "wffp sl1" and h: "hd sl1 \<in> \<delta> (last sl)"
shows "wffp (sl @ sl1)"
trg:
using assms proof (induction sl arbitrary: sl1)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a sl)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases sl1)
    case Nil
    then show ?thesis using Cons.prems by simp
  next
    case (Cons a' sl1')
    then have "wffp sl1'" using Cons.prems by simp
    then have "wffp (sl1' @ [a'])" using Cons.prems by simp
    then have "wffp (sl @ sl1')" using Cons.IH[of sl1'] Cons.prems by simp
    then show ?thesis using Cons.prems by simp
  qed
qed

lemma sunflower_lower_bound:
  assumes inf: "infinite (UNIV :: 'a set)" 
    and r: "r \<noteq> 0"
    and rk: "r = 1 \<Longrightarrow> k \<noteq> 0" 
  shows "\<exists> F. 
    card F = (r - 1)^k \<and> finite F \<and>
    (\<forall> A \<in> F. finite (A :: 'a set) \<and> card A = k) \<and>
    (\<nexists> S. S \<subseteq> F \<and> sunflower S \<and> card S \<ge> r)"
trg:
using rk
proof (induct k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases "r = 1")
    case True
    then show ?thesis using Suc.prems(2) by auto
  next
    case False
    then have "r > 1" by simp
    define r' where "r' = r - 1"
    have "r' > 0" using False r' by simp
    have "r' = 1 \<Longrightarrow> k \<noteq> 0" using Suc.prems(2) r' by simp
    then obtain F where F: "card F = r'^k" "finite F"
      "\<forall>A\<in>F. finite A \<and> card A = k"
      "\<nexists>S. S \<subseteq> F \<and> sunflower S \<and> card S \<ge> r'"
      using Suc.hyps by auto
    define F' where "F' = (\<lambda>A. A \<union> {0}) ` F"
    have "card F' = r'^(k+1)"
      using F(1) r' by (simp add: F'_def)
    moreover have "finite F'"

    moreover have "\<forall>A\<in>F'. finite A \<and> card A = k + 1"
      using F(3) by (auto simp: F'_def)
    moreover have "\<nexists>S. S \<subseteq> F' \<and> sunflower S \<and> card S \<ge> r"

lemma list_insert:
assumes A: "finite A" and b: "b \<notin> A"
shows
"\<exists> al1 al2.
   A = set (al1 @ al2) \<and> distinct (al1 @ [b] @ al2) \<and>
   list (insert b A) = al1 @ [b] @ al2"
trg:
using A b
proof (induct A)
  case empty
  then show ?case
    by (metis append_Nil distinct.simps(1) list.simps(1) set_empty)
next
  case (insert x F)
  then have "x \<notin> F" by simp
  then obtain al1 al2 where
    "F = set (al1 @ al2)" and
    "distinct (al1 @ [x] @ al2)" and
    "list (insert x F) = al1 @ [x] @ al2"
    by (metis insert.hyps(1) insert.hyps(2) insert.prems)
  then have "set (al1 @ al2) = F"
    by simp
  then have "set (al1 @ [x] @ al2) = insert x F"
    by (metis `distinct (al1 @ [x] @ al2)` `list (insert x F) = al1 @ [x] @ al2` distinct.simps(2) list.simps(2) set_append)
  then show ?case
    by (metis `distinct (al1 @ [x] @ al2)` `list (insert x F) = al1 @ [x] @ al2` distinct.simps(2) list.simps(2) set_append)
qed

lemma nv2L_simps[simp]:
"nv2L (Pos (Pr p Tl)) = (case polC p of Fext \<Rightarrow> \<Union> (set (map nv2T Tl)) |_ \<Rightarrow> {})"
"nv2L (Neg (Pr p Tl)) = (case polC p of Text \<Rightarrow> \<Union> (set (map nv2T Tl)) |_ \<Rightarrow> {})"

lemma isGuard_simps[simp]:
"isGuard x (Pos (Pr p Tl)) \<longleftrightarrow> x \<in> \<Union> (set (map nv2T Tl)) \<and> polC p = Text"
"isGuard x (Neg (Pr p Tl)) \<longleftrightarrow> x \<in> \<Union> (set (map nv2T Tl)) \<and> polC p = Fext"

  apply (induct a)

lemma list_all2_intT_int_transE_nv2T[simp]:
assumes wt: "list_all Ik.wt Tl" and \<xi>: "I.wtE \<xi>" and
nv2T: "\<And> x. \<lbrakk>\<not> infTp (tpOfV x); \<exists>T\<in>set Tl. x \<in> nv2T T\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>

lemma Union_quotient_restricted:
  assumes "equiv A r"
  assumes "P respects r"
  shows "\<Union>({x \<in> A. P x} // r) = {x \<in> A. P x}"
trg:
using assms
proof (prove)
  show "\<Union>({x \<in> A. P x} // r) = {x \<in> A. P x}"
  proof (rule equalityI)
    show "\<Union>({x \<in> A. P x} // r) \<subseteq> {x \<in> A. P x}"
    proof (rule subsetI)
      fix x assume "x \<in> \<Union>({x \<in> A. P x} // r)"
      then obtain y where "y \<in> {x \<in> A. P x}" and "x \<in> [y]r"
        by (metis UnionE quotientE)
      then show "x \<in> {x \<in> A. P x}"
        by (metis assms(1) assms(2) equiv_class_eq_iff quotientE)
    qed
    show "{x \<in> A. P x} \<subseteq> \<Union>({x \<in> A. P x} // r)"
    proof (rule subsetI)
      fix x assume "x \<in> {x \<in> A. P x}"
      then have "x \<in> A" and "P x" by simp_all
      then have "x \<in> [x]r"
        by (metis assms(1) equiv_class_refl)
      then have "{x} \<in> {x \<in> A. P x} // r"
        by (metis quotientI)
      then show "x \<in> \<Union>({x \<in> A. P x} // r)"
        by (metis UnionI)
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma finite_same_card_bij_on_ext_funcset:

trg:

  case empty

    by (metis bij_betw_empty1 empty_iff empty_set extensional_funcset_empty1)
next

    by (metis card_Diff_singleton diff_Suc_1)

    using insert.IH[of "B - {f x}"] insert.prems(2) by auto
  define g where "g = (\<lambda>y. if y = f x then x else f y)"
  have "g \<in> A \<union> {x} \<rightarrow>\<^sub>E B"
    using f(1) by (auto simp: g_def)
  moreover have "bij_betw g (A \<union> {x}) B"
    unfolding bij_betw_def inj_on_def
  proof (intro conjI ballI impI)
    show "inj_on g (A \<union> {x})"
      using f(2) unfolding bij_betw_def inj_on_def g_def by (auto simp: inj_on_def)
    show "g ` (A \<union> {x}) = B"
      using f(2) unfolding bij_betw_def g_def by (auto simp: image_iff)
  qed
  ultimately show ?case
    by blast
qed

    using assms(2) assms(3) point_def by blast

    shows "start_points x = 0"

proof (prove)

      by (metis assms cycle.simps(1) cycle_def)
  qed
  show "end_points x = 0"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "end_points x ≠ 0"
    then obtain i where "i < end_points x"
      by (metis assms cycle.simps(1) cycle_def)
    then have "x (end_points x - 1) = 0"
      by (metis assms cycle.simps(1) cycle_def)
    then have "x (end_points x) = 0"
      by (metis assms cycle.simps(1) cycle_def)
    then show False
      by (metis assms cycle.simps(1) cycle_def)
  qed

lemma W_complete_lemma [rule_format (no_asm)]:

               (\<exists>S t. (\<exists>m. W e A n = Some (S,t,m)) \<and>
                       (\<exists>R. $S' A = $R ($S A) \<and> t' = $R t))"

trg:

  (auto simp add: fresh_star_def fresh_atm)

lemma downset_mapI: "downset xss \<Longrightarrow> downset (map f ` xss)"

lemma downset_filter:
  assumes "downset xss"
  shows "downset (filter P ` xss)"
trg:
using assms
proof (rule downsetI)
  fix xs
  assume "xs \<in> set xss"
  then have "set xs \<subseteq> set (concat xss)"
    by (metis set_concat subsetI)
  then have "set (filter P xs) \<subseteq> set (concat (filter P ` xss))"
    by (metis (no_types, lifting) image_eqI set_filter subsetI)
  then show "set (filter P xs) \<subseteq> set (concat (filter P ` xss))"
    by blast
qed

end

lemma CCexp_pre_simps:
  "CCexp (Var x)\<cdot>n = \<bottom>"
  "CCexp (Lam [x]. e)\<cdot>n = predCC (fv (Lam [x]. e)) (CCexp e)\<cdot>n"
  "CCexp (App e x)\<cdot>n = CCexp e\<cdot>(inc\<cdot>n) \<squnion> ccProd {x} (insert x (fv e))"
  "\<not> nonrec \<Gamma> \<Longrightarrow>
      CCexp (Let \<Gamma> e)\<cdot>n = cc_restr (fv (Let \<Gamma> e))
        (CCfix \<Gamma>\<cdot>(Afix \<Gamma>\<cdot>(Aexp e\<cdot>n \<squnion> (\<lambda>_.up\<cdot>0) f|` thunks \<Gamma>), CCexp e\<cdot>n))"
  "x \<notin> fv e \<Longrightarrow> CCexp (let x be e in exp)\<cdot>n =
    cc_restr (fv (let x be e in exp))
       (ccBind x e \<cdot>(Aheap_nonrec x e\<cdot>(Aexp exp\<cdot>n, CCexp exp\<cdot>n), CCexp exp\<cdot>n)
       \<squnion> ccProd (fv e) (ccNeighbors x (CCexp exp\<cdot>n) - (if isVal e then {} else {x})) \<squnion> CCexp exp\<cdot>n)"
  "CCexp (Bool b)\<cdot>n = \<bottom>"
  "CCexp (scrut ? e1 : e2)\<cdot>n =
       CCexp scrut\<cdot>0 \<squnion>
       (CCexp e1\<cdot>n \<squnion> CCexp e2\<cdot>n) \<squnion>
       ccProd (edom (Aexp scrut\<cdot>0)) (edom (Aexp e1\<cdot>n) \<union> edom (Aexp e2\<cdot>n))"
trg:
by (auto simp: Aexp_pre_simps Aheap_pre_simps Afix_pre_simps
      intro!: arg_cong2[where f=cc_restr] arg_cong2[where f=ccBind]
      intro: cc_restr_cong ccBind_cong)

lemma CCexp_simps[simp]:

  "\<G>\<^bsub>0\<^esub>(Lam [x]. e) = (fv (Lam [x]. e))\<^sup>2"
  "\<G>\<^bsub>inc\<cdot>a\<^esub>(Lam [x]. e) = cc_delete x (\<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e)"
  "\<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> (App e x) = \<G>\<^bsub>inc\<cdot>a\<^esub> e \<squnion> {x} G\<times>insert x (fv e)"
  "\<not> nonrec \<Gamma> \<Longrightarrow> \<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> (Let \<Gamma> e) =
    (CCfix \<Gamma>\<cdot>(Afix \<Gamma>\<cdot>(\<A>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e \<squnion> (\<lambda>_.up\<cdot>0) f|` thunks \<Gamma>), \<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e)) G|` (- domA \<Gamma>)"
  "x \<notin> fv e' \<Longrightarrow> \<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> (let x be e' in e) =
    cc_delete x
       (ccBind x e' \<cdot>(Aheap_nonrec x e'\<cdot>(\<A>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e, \<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e), \<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e)
       \<squnion> fv e' G\<times> (ccNeighbors x (\<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e) - (if isVal e' then {} else {x})) \<squnion> \<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e)"
  "\<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> (Bool b) = \<bottom>"
  "\<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> (scrut ? e1 : e2) =
       \<G>\<^bsub>0\<^esub> scrut \<squnion> (\<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e1 \<squnion> \<G>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e2) \<squnion>
       edom (\<A>\<^bsub>0\<^esub> scrut) G\<times> (edom (\<A>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e1) \<union> edom (\<A>\<^bsub>a\<^esub> e2))"

  assumes "c \<Rightarrow>\<^sup>* c'"
  assumes "\<not> boring_step c'"
  assumes "invariant (\<Rightarrow>) I"
  assumes "I c"
  assumes app\<^sub>1:  "\<And> \<Gamma> e x S . I (\<Gamma>, App e x, S) \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, App e x, S)  (\<Gamma>, e , Arg x # S)"
  assumes app\<^sub>2:  "\<And> \<Gamma> y e x S . I (\<Gamma>, Lam [y]. e, Arg x # S) \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, Lam [y]. e, Arg x # S) (\<Gamma>, e[y ::= x] , S)"
  assumes thunk:  "\<And> \<Gamma> x e S . map_of \<Gamma> x = Some e \<Longrightarrow> \<not> isVal e \<Longrightarrow> I (\<Gamma>, Var x, S) \<Longrightarrow>  P (\<Gamma>, Var x, S) (delete x \<Gamma>, e , Upd x # S)"
  assumes lamvar:  "\<And> \<Gamma> x e S . map_of \<Gamma> x = Some e \<Longrightarrow> isVal e \<Longrightarrow> I (\<Gamma>, Var x, S) \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, Var x, S) ((x,e) # delete x \<Gamma>, e , S)"
  assumes var\<^sub>2:  "\<And> \<Gamma> x e S . x \<notin> domA \<Gamma> \<Longrightarrow> isVal e \<Longrightarrow> I (\<Gamma>, e, Upd x # S) \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, e, Upd x # S) ((x,e)# \<Gamma>, e , S)"
  assumes let\<^sub>1:  "\<And> \<Delta> \<Gamma> e S . atom ` domA \<Delta> \<sharp>* \<Gamma> \<Longrightarrow> atom ` domA \<Delta> \<sharp>* S \<Longrightarrow> I (\<Gamma>, Let \<Delta> e, S) \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, Let \<Delta> e, S) (\<Delta>@\<Gamma>, e, S)"
  assumes if\<^sub>1:   "\<And>\<Gamma> scrut e1 e2 S. I  (\<Gamma>, scrut ? e1 : e2, S) \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, scrut ? e1 : e2, S) (\<Gamma>, scrut, Alts e1 e2 # S)"
  assumes if\<^sub>2:   "\<And>\<Gamma> b e1 e2 S. I  (\<Gamma>, Bool b, Alts e1 e2 # S) \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, Bool b, Alts e1 e2 # S) (\<Gamma>, if b then e1 else e2, S)"
  assumes refl: "\<And> c. P c c"
  assumes trans[trans]: "\<And> c c' c''. c \<Rightarrow>\<^sup>* c' \<Longrightarrow> c' \<Rightarrow>\<^sup>* c'' \<Longrightarrow> P c c' \<Longrightarrow> P c' c'' \<Longrightarrow> P c c''"

  assumes "c \<Rightarrow>\<^sup>* c'"
  assumes "\<not> boring_step c'"
  assumes app\<^sub>1:  "\<And> \<Gamma> e x S . P (\<Gamma>, App e x, S)  (\<Gamma>, e , Arg x # S)"
  assumes app\<^sub>2:  "\<And> \<Gamma> y e x S . P (\<Gamma>, Lam [y]. e, Arg x # S) (\<Gamma>, e[y ::= x] , S)"
  assumes thunk:  "\<And> \<Gamma> x e S . map_of \<Gamma> x = Some e \<Longrightarrow> \<not> isVal e \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, Var x, S) (delete x \<Gamma>, e , Upd x # S)"
  assumes lamvar:  "\<And> \<Gamma> x e S . map_of \<Gamma> x = Some e \<Longrightarrow> isVal e \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, Var x, S) ((x,e) # delete x \<Gamma>, e , S)"
  assumes var\<^sub>2:  "\<And> \<Gamma> x e S . x \<notin> domA \<Gamma> \<Longrightarrow> isVal e \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, e, Upd x # S) ((x,e)# \<Gamma>, e , S)"
  assumes let\<^sub>1:  "\<And> \<Delta> \<Gamma> e S . atom ` domA \<Delta> \<sharp>* \<Gamma> \<Longrightarrow> atom ` domA \<Delta> \<sharp>* S \<Longrightarrow> P (\<Gamma>, Let \<Delta> e, S) (\<Delta>@\<Gamma>, e, S)"
  assumes if\<^sub>1:   "\<And>\<Gamma> scrut e1 e2 S. P (\<Gamma>, scrut ? e1 : e2, S) (\<Gamma>, scrut, Alts e1 e2 # S)"
  assumes if\<^sub>2:   "\<And>\<Gamma> b e1 e2 S. P (\<Gamma>, Bool b, Alts e1 e2 # S) (\<Gamma>, if b then e1 else e2, S)"
  assumes refl: "\<And> c. P c c"
  assumes trans[trans]: "\<And> c c' c''. c \<Rightarrow>\<^sup>* c' \<Longrightarrow> c' \<Rightarrow>\<^sup>* c'' \<Longrightarrow> P c c' \<Longrightarrow> P c' c'' \<Longrightarrow> P c c''"
  shows "P c c'"
trg:
using assms
proof (prove)
  apply (induction c c' rule: step_induction)
  apply (auto intro: refl)
  done

end
